pack.name: Jules' Homestead
pack.summary: A grounded homestead-to-town survival pack: seasons, storms and blizzards, renewable power for real appliances, residents and a hand-written quest book.

warnings: zoomify: declared required dependency unresolvable (kotlin-lang-forge: no ['fabric'] version for Minecraft 26.1.2); verify via jar metadata

files.title: Ambient Environment
files.purpose: Subtle colour variation in grass, leaves and water (Bedrock-style), so landscapes feel less flat.

files.title: Animal Feeding Trough
files.purpose: Livestock feeding troughs (animal husbandry automation without industry).

files.title: Camera Overhaul
files.purpose: Gentle camera roll/sway for first-person immersion (tuned down in configs; can be disabled).

files.title: Carry On
files.purpose: Pick up chests/animals while moving house.

files.title: Crate Delight
files.purpose: Crop crates for compact produce storage.

files.title: Create Fly
files.purpose: OPTIONAL Create (community Fabric port). Mechanical only; not electricity. Off unless chosen at import.

files.title: Crops Love Rain
files.purpose: Crops grow faster in rain — weather matters to farms.

files.title: Distant Horizons
files.purpose: Optional long-distance terrain LOD. Off by default (performance cost).

files.title: Easy NPC
files.purpose: Hand-placed town NPCs (mentor/mayor) with dialog and trades.

files.title: EasyNPC x FTB Quests Compat
files.purpose: Lets Easy NPC dialog actions open/complete FTB quests.

files.title: Energized Power
files.purpose: Electrical backbone on TR Energy: solar I-IV, coal engine, battery boxes, cables, powered lamp/furnace, crusher.

files.title: Entity Culling
files.purpose: Skip rendering hidden (block-)entities — important with furnished houses.

files.title: Explorify
files.purpose: Vanilla-friendly small structures (camps, ruins, houses) that make travel interesting.

files.title: Farmer's Delight Refabricated
files.purpose: Cooking backbone: cooking pot, skillet, cutting board, stove, meals, rice/tomato/cabbage/onion.

files.title: Farming for Blockheads
files.purpose: Market (buy seeds/saplings/animals), shipping bin (sell produce), sprinklers (irrigation), feeding trough.

files.title: First-person Model
files.purpose: See your body in first person.

files.title: Friends&Foes (Fabric/Quilt)
files.purpose: Vanilla-style mobs (moobloom, beekeeper villagers, copper golem helpers).

files.title: Frostiful
files.purpose: Cold content: freezing, fur armour, warmth from light/fire. (26.1.x build is labelled beta upstream.)

files.title: ftb-library-fabric
files.purpose: FTB Quests dependency (official FTB maven, All Rights Reserved — referenced, not re-hosted).
files.distribution: Referenced from FTB's official maven; not re-hosted (All Rights Reserved).

files.title: ftb-quests-fabric
files.purpose: Quest book UI, pinned-quest HUD tracker, rewards. Content authored in quests/.
files.distribution: Referenced from FTB's official maven; not re-hosted (All Rights Reserved).

files.title: ftb-teams-fabric
files.distribution: Referenced from FTB's official maven; not re-hosted (All Rights Reserved).

files.title: ftb-xmod-compat-fabric
files.distribution: Referenced from FTB's official maven; not re-hosted (All Rights Reserved).

files.title: Fusion (Connected Textures)
files.purpose: Connected-texture library required by Rechiseled's jar on BOTH sides (Modrinth marks it client-only).

files.title: Gardener's Dream
files.purpose: Place any plant in flower pots and decorated pots (cozy decorating).

files.title: GlitchCore
files.purpose: Required by Serene Seasons' jar (not declared in Modrinth metadata; found by tools/validate.py).

files.title: homestead-core
files.purpose: Custom: severe fronts (storm/blizzard), shelter/exposure, forecast, wind turbine, water wheel, refrigerator, electric range, space heater.

files.title: homestead-pack-data
files.purpose: Custom data module: Serene Seasons tags for Farmer's Delight/Ube's/Rustic crops, removes EP weather & time controllers.

files.title: Iris Shaders
files.purpose: Shader loader. Installed but shaders OFF by default (optional preset).

files.title: Legendary Tooltips
files.purpose: Framed, readable item tooltips with item previews (pleasant screens).

files.title: Macaw's Paths and Pavings
files.purpose: Paths and pavings for town streets.

files.title: MCA Reborn
files.purpose: Residents with families, moods, professions, building detection, taxes. AI chat disabled by default.

files.title: Mod Menu
files.purpose: In-game mod list and config entry points.

files.title: More Delight (for Farmer's Delight)
files.purpose: Extra Farmer's Delight meals and ingredients.

files.title: Nuit
files.purpose: Custom skybox support (formerly FabricSkyboxes) for the Dramatic Skys resource pack.

files.title: Overflowing Bars
files.purpose: Compact health/armour rows (thermoo-patches ships a compatibility patch for it).

files.title: Particle Rain
files.purpose: Particle rain/snow visuals (client). Compatible with Immersive Storms per its docs.

files.title: Remove Stardust Labs Intro Message
files.purpose: Removes the Stardust Labs intro chat message on world join (cleaner first impression).

files.title: RightClickHarvest
files.purpose: Right-click to harvest and replant crops.

files.title: Remove Reloading Screen
files.purpose: Resource reloads happen in the background instead of a blocking full-screen overlay.

files.title: Rustic Delight
files.purpose: Bell peppers, coffee, cotton; Farmer's Delight style dishes.

files.title: Scorchful
files.purpose: Heat + thirst in hot conditions; bundles Immersive Storms (snow/sand fog in thunderstorms, client).

files.title: Serene Seasons
files.purpose: OWNER of seasons: seasonal biome temperature, crop fertility, winter snow.

files.title: Snow Under Trees
files.purpose: Snow settles under trees in snowy biomes / winter (supports Serene Seasons and Terralith).

files.title: Sodium Extra
files.purpose: Extra Sodium video options (fog, particles, animations).

files.title: Spatial GUI
files.purpose: Inventory and container screens drawn as a 3D panel in the world (camera swings to third person, player faces the panel). Client-only; needs YACL + Mod Menu (already in the pack).

files.title: Spoiled
files.purpose: OWNER of food spoilage. Slow defaults; homestead-core fridge preserves while powered.

files.title: Structory
files.purpose: Atmospheric ruins and small structures with light lore (Stardust Labs, designed alongside Terralith).

files.title: Subtle Effects
files.purpose: Ambient detail: fire sparks, better smoke, snoring Z's, dust clouds, glowing dust; every effect toggleable. Replaces Visuality.

files.title: Tectonic
files.purpose: Terrain shape (mountains, rivers) — designed to pair with Terralith.

files.title: Terralith
files.purpose: OWNER of overworld biomes (vanilla-block biomes, lush forests, rivers).

files.title: Thermoo
files.purpose: OWNER of body temperature (API). homestead-core feeds blizzard cold and heater warmth through it.

files.title: Thermoo Patches
files.purpose: Verified Thermoo<->Serene Seasons bridge (bundled serene-seasons patch).

files.title: Towns and Towers
files.purpose: Varied villages/outposts worth exploring (not a finished town to move into).

files.title: Ube's Delight
files.purpose: Additional crops (ube, garlic, ginger, lemongrass) and dishes using Farmer's Delight tags.

files.title: Wakes
files.purpose: Boat and swimming wakes/splashes on water.

files.title: Clean Connected Glass
files.purpose: Connected glass without streaks (via Continuity) — windows and greenhouses.

files.title: Dramatic Skys
files.purpose: HD skies with realistic clouds (needs Nuit). Baseline without shaders.

files.title: Even Better Enchants
files.purpose: Distinct enchanted book textures (vanilla item models, no CIT mod needed on 26.1).

files.title: (Bee's) Fancy Crops
files.purpose: Prettier crops; built to work with Farmer's Delight.

files.title: Fresh Animations: Details
files.purpose: Official Fresh Animations extension: extra mob details.

files.title: Fresh Animations: Objects
files.purpose: Official Fresh Animations extension: animates non-mob entities.

files.title: Fresh Flower Pots
files.purpose: Detailed flower pots (pairs with Gardener's Dream).

files.title: New Glowing Ores
files.purpose: Optional: glowing ore outlines (accessibility); shipped but off.

files.title: Recolourful Containers GUI + HUD
files.purpose: Warm, themed container screens (wooden crafting table, stone anvil, …); vanilla+ mode without OptiGUI.

files.title: Simple Grass Flowers
files.purpose: Vanilla-friendly flowers, clovers and pebbles on grass.

files.title: Theone's Eating Animation Pack
files.purpose: Eating/drinking animations for food (no mod needed).

files.title: Visual: Armor Trims
files.purpose: Armour trims visible on inventory icons.

files.title: Complementary Shaders - Reimagined
files.purpose: Optional 'Cinematic' preset shader (vanilla-faithful). Off by default.

files.title: MakeUp - Ultra Fast
files.purpose: Optional lightweight shader for lower-end GPUs.

files.title: Mellow
files.purpose: Optional painterly, cozy and light shader (MIT).

files.title: Photon Shaders
files.purpose: Optional high-end semi-realistic shader (cinematic, strong GPU).
